findings.evidence: him
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has an ambiguous antecedent (it could refer to the Member, the Guarantor, or the Librarian) and assumes male gender.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: The password-reset token expiration time is left as 'TBD' instead of a concrete duration.

findings.evidence: user-friendly Member dashboard that is easy to navigate and loads rapidly on standard connections
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') without measurable acceptance criteria.

findings.evidence: TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: The maximum number of consecutive loan renewals is left as 'TBD'.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Specifies validating item eligibility and issuing a receipt, but omits error handling and rejection behavior when an item is ineligible or validation fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number
findings.rationale: References 'the allowed maximum number' of active hold requests without defining the numeric limit anywhere in the SRS.

findings.evidence: up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Permits borrowing up to 8 physical items simultaneously, conflicting with SD-009 which limits an active Member in good standing to at most 5 physical items.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, conflicting with SD-010 which specifies 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Allows self-registration with only an email address and immediate book checkout without ID verification, conflicting with SD-001 which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email, and phone number.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Requires reserved items on the pickup shelf to remain held indefinitely until explicit cancellation, conflicting with SD-011 which expires and cancels uncollected holds after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Chained 'and/or' operators make it ambiguous which combination of the three actions must be executed when an item becomes 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Passive phrasing omits both the human/role actor responsible for reviewing and approving waiver requests and the system component that records them in the audit log.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: The weak phrase 'if appropriate' leaves the decision to send SMS due-date alerts discretionary and unverifiable.

findings.evidence: before the due date if appropriate
findings.rationale: Omits the lead-time value and unit specifying how far before the due date to dispatch SMS alerts, as well as the condition defining when an alert is appropriate.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: The retention period for payment receipts before archival purge is marked as 'TBD'.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine of $1.25 USD per day with no cap, conflicting with SD-019 which sets the fine at $0.50 USD per day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Permits renewing items regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance, conflicting with SD-020 which blocks Members with unpaid fines exceeding $5.00 USD from renewing items.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count and enforce the 5-item borrowing limit on the Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Introduces the undefined term 'Patron' instead of the established term 'Member' used across earlier requirements (e.g., SD-009), and reiterates the 5-item borrowing limit that conflicts with SD-015's 8-item limit.

findings.evidence: quickly even when many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms 'quickly' (no response-time bound) and 'many' (no concurrent-user threshold).

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: The weak phrase 'where possible' makes query-term highlighting discretionary without defining the conditions under which it is required or omitted.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy and acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms 'sufficient' and 'acceptable' without measurable accuracy metrics or latency thresholds.

findings.evidence: efficiently process large batch MARC21 files without noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms 'efficiently', 'large', and 'noticeable' without defining throughput, file size, or acceptable performance-degradation bounds.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Requires the Catalog Service to detect active loans or holds on deletion attempt, but omits the consequent action (such as blocking deletion or returning an error).

findings.evidence: TBD intervals
findings.rationale: The schedule interval for encrypted full database backups is marked as 'TBD'.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions in a timely manner and retain them for an appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms 'important', 'in a timely manner', and 'appropriate period' without specifying which actions, logging latency, or retention duration.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security and clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms 'adequate' and 'clear' without specifying concrete transport security protocols/ciphers or error-message requirements.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any Member password of at least 8 characters, conflicting with SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of inactivity, conflicting with SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 encryption so passwords can be decrypted, conflicting with SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing and prohibits storing or retrieving plaintext passwords.
